discovery: A gang of bandits has surrounded a merchant caravan, stripping valuables from the carts while terrified traders look on.

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Try to observe without being seen

sneak_success: Keeping low behind the brush, you watch the bandits finish looting the caravan before disappearing into the wilderness. Once they're gone, you search what little they left behind.
sneak_fail: Your footing gives way with a sharp crack. Every bandit turns toward you, weapons drawn.
ignore: You turn away as the merchants plead for help. Their desperate voices soon fade into the distance.

victim_data.dialogue: Please... they'll kill us if nobody helps!
thanks: You saved our lives. We owe you everything.
after: We don't have much left, but please accept this as our thanks.

aftermath.discovery: The surviving merchants gather what remains of their caravan, tending to the wounded and counting their losses.

choices.label: Escort the Caravan
choices.description: See them safely back to Northfield
choices.outcome: You escort the battered caravan back to Northfield without further incident. The grateful merchants spread word of your bravery, and pool together a modest reward.

choices.label: Help Recover Supplies
choices.outcome: You spend some time gathering scattered goods and repairing what you can. The merchants thank you before continuing their journey.

choices.label: Leave
choices.outcome: With the danger gone, you leave the merchants to sort through the wreckage on their own.
